note: The runtime capabilities each harness declares for the model-adaptive executor lane (S12). A harness that is not listed here declares NOTHING: the executor-profile resolution then fails closed with MODEL_PROFILE_HARNESS_CAPABILITY_MISSING instead of assuming a capability. The capability vocabulary is closed and owned by core/contracts/executor-model-profile.schema.json (runtime_requirements). This file is a declaration surface, not an authority surface: it grants no permission, confers no qualification and never widens the execution profile.
